decisions.statement: Nothing outside akasha asks an agent which bodies the agent has read.
A seat refused for an unread document may read and search.
A seat refused for an unread document does nothing else.
A seat is allowed to act where nothing identifies the agent.
A landing into akasha is refused where nothing identifies the agent.
A context replaced takes every reading the agent has made.
A body in the system prompt survives a context replacement.
A record names the body read apart from the body a mechanical change left.
An act is refused until its required reading is read.
Only a read the akasha system runs counts as read.
A body counts as read by the agent that landed that body.
A read stops counting when the body read changes unless a mechanical change carried the read on.
A refusal names the reading the refusal wants and the route that records that reading.
The reading a seat must do is worked out from the statements on its page rather than listed.
No reading an agent needs falls outside the warrants.
A seat assigned an initiative reads that initiative's type.
A seat assigned an initiative reads the persona that initiative states.
The tool definitions have context nobody here controls.

definition: the reading an agent cannot skip

directives.name: Route Not Text
directives.act: Name the reading and the route that records it; never hand the agent the text.
directives.warrant: Handed text is disbelieved or truncated, and the record then shows a reading that never happened.
aids: Send neither the text nor a stand-in for it.
A line quoted to point at work is not the text.

directives.name: Dilution
directives.act: Weigh an instruction against every reader at every boot, never against the one it was written for.
directives.warrant: The cost is not the line but the weight it takes off every other line, and nothing reports that.
aids: Put a line on the narrowest document it serves.
Never reword a narrow line to sound general.
